title: Native Select
description: The browser's own select, for choices autofill or the phone's picker should fill, such as a country in an address; mutes the empty option as a placeholder.

components.NativeSelect: Lets the user pick one option from a list using the browser's own picker.
components.NativeSelectOptGroup: Groups related options of the native select under a shared heading.
components.NativeSelectOption: Offers one choice the user can pick in the native select.
